film.title: The SHOCKING Best Season in Ohio Sports History (You Won't Believe #1)
film.description:
We ranked the best seasons in Ohio sports history. We asked absolutely zero experts. Number one will shock you.

The countdown: 2014 Ohio State football, the 1961 and 1962 Cincinnati Bearcats, the 1964 Browns, the 1995 Indians, the 1948 Indians, the 1976 Reds, and the 2016 Cavaliers... or is it?

Then the real story: the 1944-45 Bowling Green Falcons. A small school in a farm town, in the middle of a war, with Navy men on the roster. 24-4, no one in the country won more games. Wyndol Gray, Bowling Green's first All-American. Don Otten, one of the three big men behind the goaltending rule. A trip to the NIT at Madison Square Garden, revenge on St. John's before 18,000, and a final against George Mikan's DePaul, held scoreless for the first five minutes.

Best Runs, a Hardwood Bricks series. Hosted by Matthew Hagan. Matthew appears in the deep dive as an AI avatar made with HeyGen. Gary Mercer is a fictional AI anchor. Historical photos from Wikimedia Commons (public domain or free license, credited in the film). Arena and ballpark photos by Hardwood Bricks. Music is original.

Keep it mid. Keep it real. See more at https://hardwoodbricks.com

reels.title: The SHOCKING best season in Ohio history
reels.text: You already know number one. The 2016 Cavs. Is what you thought we were going to say. The actual number one: the 1944-45 Bowling Green Falcons.

reels.title: Five minutes. Zero.
reels.text: Bowling Green, 1945 NIT final at Madison Square Garden. George Mikan had just scored 53 in the semifinal. For the first five minutes, Bowling Green did not let DePaul score. At all.
